crops.kind: Exact saved 24x24 uint8 crops on accepted frames; missing input is zero

heat.display_encoding: Per-frame max normalized to 255 for visibility; not model input values

video.frame_mapping: Output frame i corresponds to source frame i for all 349 frames at 30 fps. Browser-compatible H.264/yuv420p transcode; no crop, stabilization, overlays or frame exclusions. Compression changes pixel values; detection and XYZ predictions are unchanged.

provenance.labels_usage: Only independent 2D evaluation after all four predictions were frozen. Label positions are not supplied as detection coordinates or model inputs; no 3D truth is available.
provenance.selection: Previously selected by lower 2D mean. Withdrawn as successful demonstration on 2026-11-06 after visible ground/airborne contradiction. Retained as failure case.
provenance.detector_pretraining_overlap: Unknown for this exact frozen checkpoint, despite original Test split designation.
provenance.license: Underlying broadcast video redistribution license was not independently established; source and dataset are attributed. Public convenience mirror does not establish ownership of footage.
provenance.camera: Same fixed oblique rear camera as the previously manually calibrated Test/match1 reference. Sampled registration anchor shift <=0.20 px; no frame registration applied.
provenance.depth: Saved ST3D coordinates with existing overlap fusion and geometric/temporal refinement. Lower 2D reprojection error does not validate metric 3D depth.
provenance.missing_detection_encoding: Original nonfinite missing-detection coordinates become JSON null; observed/detected masks are unchanged. No imputed detector locations.

failure_review.visual_evidence: Shuttle on floor near far baseline while output is airborne in near half. No measured 3D ground truth; qualitative failure already visible.
